answerCheck.reason: With orbital angle theta measured clockwise, equal no-slip contact arcs give relative disk turn psi=(R/r)*theta. The line of centers itself turns by theta, so the marked arrow turns clockwise in the fixed frame by phi=psi+theta=((R+r)/r)*theta. For R=20 and r=10 this is 3*theta. The first positive full-turn return phi=360 degrees occurs at theta=120 degrees, or 4 oclock, C. An arc-length-only calculation omitting the moving frame would incorrectly predict 6 oclock.

flags: Uses the standard interpretation that rolling occurs without slipping.
No slipping is the ordinary rolling model; without it the arrow orientation is not determined.

routes.label: Match contact arcs and combine the turns
